ko.title: 투표용지 이미 발송됨, 선거구 여전히 분쟁 중: 미주리 대법원의 선거구 재편 싸움 내부

segments.src: Missouri voters are starting to receive and return ballots for the November 3 election.
segments.tr: 미주리 유권자들이 11월 3일 선거를 위한 투표용지를 받기 시작했고 반환하고 있다.

segments.src: The congressional map those ballots are based on may not be the one that ends up being used.
segments.tr: 그 투표용지가 기반을 두고 있는 의회 선거구 지도가 결국 사용될 지도가 아닐 수도 있다.

segments.src: A federal appeals court has ordered Missouri to use a Republican-drawn congressional map that dissolves a Kansas City-based Democratic district.
segments.tr: 연방 항소 법원이 미주리에게 캔자스시티에 기반을 둔 민주당 선거구를 해산하는 공화당이 그린 의회 선거구 지도를 사용하도록 명령했다.

segments.src: The order came even though ballots reflecting the older district lines had already been printed and mailed.
segments.tr: 기존 선거구 경계선을 반영한 투표용지가 이미 인쇄되고 발송된 후에도 이 명령이 내려졌다.

segments.src: On Tuesday night, the dispute went back to the U.S.
segments.tr: 화요일 밤, 분쟁이 미국

segments.src: Supreme Court, the third time in September that the justices have been asked to step in.
segments.tr: 대법원에 돌아갔는데, 9월에 판사들이 개입해달라고 요청받은 세 번째 경우다.

segments.src: This article explains what happened, what each side argues, and what is still unsettled.
segments.tr: 이 기사는 무슨 일이 있었는지, 각 측에서 주장하는 것이 무엇인지, 그리고 여전히 미해결된 것이 무엇인지를 설명한다.

segments.src: The situation is changing quickly, and details are current as of September 24, 2026.
segments.tr: 상황이 빠르게 변하고 있으며, 세부 사항은 2026년 9월 24일 현재이다.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **싸움의 대상:** 미주리가 2026년 11월 총선에서 사용할 두 개의 의회 선거구 지도 중 어느 것. 하나는 2022년 지도이고, 다른 하나는 2025년 공화당이 주도하는 입법부가 통과시킨 지도다.

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **가장 직접적으로 영향받는 사람들:** 캔자스시티 및 그 주변의 유권자들. 2025년 지도는 민주당 미국 하원의원 에마누엘 클리버 II가 보유하고 있는 제5의회 선거구를 해산한다.

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **현재 상황:** 제8연방항소법원은 9월 21일 월요일에 2025년 지도가 사용되어야 한다고 판결했다. 그 판결은 대법원에 행동할 시간을 주기 위해 9월 28일 월요일까지 일시 중단되어 있다.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **다음에 일어날 일:** 판사들은 명령을 차단하거나, 발효되도록 하거나, 사건을 검토하면서 일시 중단을 연장할 수 있다.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## 분쟁이 어떻게 여기까지 오게 되었는가

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: 싸움이 짧은 시간에 주 법원과 연방 법원을 거쳤다.

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: 다음은 뉴스 매체에서 보도한 순서이다:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025년:** 미주리 공화당원들은 미국 하원 선거구를 공화당 후보자들에게 유리한 방식으로 다시 그리기 위해 도널드 트럼프 대통령이 지지하는 광범위한 국가 캠페인의 일부로 새로운 의회 선거구 지도를 통과시켰다. 그 지도는 클리버가 대표하는 캔자스시티 지역 선거구를 재구성한다.

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **국민 투표 청원:** People Not Politicians이라는 단체가 새 지도가 발효되어야 하는지 여부를 유권자들이 결정할 수 있도록 하는 국민 투표를 위한 서명을 수집했다. 그들의 입장은 유권자들이 의견을 제시할 때까지 그 지도를 사용할 수 없다는 것이다.

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **8월 4일:** 미주리는 2025년 지도를 사용하여 당 경선을 실시했다. 주 관리들은 국민 투표 청원이 아직 인증되지 않았다고 주장했다.

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **9월 3일:** 미주리 대법원은 주 법에 따라 2025년 지도는 국민 투표에 가기 전까지 올해 중간선거에서 사용될 수 없다고 만장일치로 판결했다. 그것은 관리들에게 2022년 지도를 사용하도록 지시했다.

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **9월 초:** 미국 대법원은 미주리 관리들의 항소를 받아들이기를 거절했다. 몇 시간 후, 세인트루이스의 연방 지방 법원 판사 스티븐 클라크는 2025년 지도 외의 다른 지도를 금지하는 임시 명령을 발했다. 그 몇 일 후, 대법원은 그의 명령을 중단했으며, 이는 2022년 지도 사용 지시를 복원했다.

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **9월 21일:** 제8연방항소법원의 3인 판사 판정부는 2025년 지도의 편을 들었고 그것의 사용을 명령했다. 클라크 판사는 그러한 명령을 발했지만 항소가 진행될 수 있도록 9월 28일까지 연기했다.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **화요일 늦은 시간, 9월 22일:** People Not Politicians은 대법원에 연방 명령을 차단해달라고 요청했다. 제8연방항소법원의 긴급 문제를 처리하는 브렛 카바노 대법관은 수요일 대응에 대한 기한을 설정했다.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## 항소 법원이 그렇게 판결한 이유

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: 판결에 대한 보도에 따르면, 제8연방항소법원의 논리는 단일 선거 주기 내 일관성에 대한 헌법적 주장에 기반했다.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: 법원은 유권자들이 경선에서 사용된 선거구와 일치하는 선거구에서 의회 의원을 선출해야 한다고 말했다.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: 8월 경선은 2025년 지도 하에서 실시되었으므로, 11월을 위해 2022년 지도로 전환하면 대략 284,000명의 경선 유권자들이 총선을 위해 다른 선거구에 배치될 것이다.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: 판정부는 "2025년 지도의 사용만이 헌법과 연방법을 준수한다"고 썼다.

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: 또한 선거 운동 중에 미주리 주민들이 "의회에 출마하기 위해 등록하고, 후보자들을 만나고, 캠페인 광고를 보고, 캠페인 메일을 받고, 2025년 지도 하에서 투표했다"고 지적했다.

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: 법원은 또한 퍼셀 원칙을 다루었다.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: 이것은 유권자들과 선거 관계자들을 혼동시킬 수 있는 선거 규칙의 늦은 변경을 피하기 위해 법원들이 자주 인용하는 원칙이다.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: 판정부는 경선이 실행된 2025년 지도를 실제 현상 유지로 취급한 것으로 보도되었다.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: 따라서 그것은 그 원칙이 자신의 명령을 차단했다는 주장을 거절했다.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## 다른 측에서 말하는 것

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians과 2022년 지도의 다른 지지자들은 그것을 다르게 본다.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: 그들은 미주리 대법원의 주의 고유한 국민 투표 절차가 어떻게 작동하는지에 대한 판결을 지적한다.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: 그들은 또한 미국

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: 대법원이 이미 이번 달에 두 번 2022년 지도를 그대로 두는 방식으로 행동했다고 지적한다.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: 그 단체의 사무총장 리처드 폰 글라나는 선거 중간에 지도 변경이 실제 문제라고 주장했다.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "당신은 선거 중간에 지도를 변경할 수 없다"고 그는 말했으며, 그 단체의 입장에 대한 확신을 표현했다.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: 미주리 국무장관 및 새로운 선거구에서 출마하는 공화당 후보자들을 포함한 2025년 지도의 지지자들은 경선 결과와 그 뒤에 따른 캠페인 활동이 2025년 지도를 유효한 것으로 만든다고 주장한다.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## 투표용지 문제

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: 타이밍이 이 사건을 특이하게 만드는 것이다.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: 11월 3일 선거를 위한 투표용지는 2022년 선거구 경계선으로 인쇄되고 해외 및 군 유권자들을 포함하여 발송되었다.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: 부재자 투표는 이번 주에 시작되었다.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: 2025년 지도가 시행되면, 선거 관리들은 선거일 매우 가까이 투표용지를 재발송하거나 조정하는 작업에 직면할 것이다.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: 제8연방항소법원 자신의 명령은 2025년 지도가 통치해야 한다고 했지만, 법원도 주 관리들도 명령이 발효되면 투표용지를 어떻게 처리할 것인지에 대한 완전한 계획을 공개적으로 제시하지 않았다.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: 미주리 유권자들은 11월 3일에 2025년 지도를 승인할지 여부를 묻는 Proposition A라는 주 전역의 투표안도 보게 될 것이다.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians은 "반대" 투표를 위해 캠페인을 하고 있다.

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: 그 단체는 서명 운동에 수백만 달러를 지출했다고 보고했으며, Put Missouri First라는 위원회가 이를 반대하기 위해 지출했다.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 다음에 주목할 것

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **9월 28일 전 대법원 명령.** 기한을 감안하면, 판사들은 긴급 요청에 대해 판결하거나 일시 중단을 연장할 것으로 예상된다.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **선거 관리 지도.** 지역 선거 당국은 투표용지에 어느 선거구가 나타나는지와 이미 발송된 투표용지를 어떻게 처리할 것인지에 대한 명확한 지시가 필요하다.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **더 큰 법적 문제.** 그 사건은 연방 법원이 주 대법원의 주 법에 대한 해석에 얼마나 많은 무게를 부여해야 하는지, 그리고 경선과 총선이 다른 지도 하에서 실시될 때 "늦은 변경 금지" 원칙이 얼마나 멀리 미치는지를 시험한다.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **더 큰 의회 상황.** 캔자스시티 의석은 중간선거 앞 선거구 경계선을 놓고 벌어진 전국적인 싸움의 여러 격전지 중 하나다. 그 결과는 미국 의회의 균형에 영향을 미칠 수 있다.

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## 미주리 유권자들이 할 수 있는 것

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: 규칙이 여전히 미정상태이기 때문에, 유권자들은 소셜 미디어 루머 대신 공식 출처에 의존해야 한다:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - 지역 선거 당국 또는 미주리 국무장관 웹사이트로 등록과 현재 의회 선거구를 확인하세요.

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - 부재자 투표용지가 이미 있다면, 그것과 함께 온 지시를 따르고 지역 선거 사무소의 업데이트를 주시하세요.

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - 법원이 행동하면 지침이 변경될 수 있으므로, 투표용지를 반환하기 전에 공식 발표를 확인하세요.

zh.title: 选票已邮寄,地图仍有争议:密苏里州最高法院内的选区重划纠纷始末

segments.src: Missouri voters are starting to receive and return ballots for the November 3 election.
segments.tr: 密苏里州选民开始接收并退回11月3日选举的选票。

segments.src: The congressional map those ballots are based on may not be the one that ends up being used.
segments.tr: 那些选票所基于的国会地图可能不是最终将被使用的地图。

segments.src: A federal appeals court has ordered Missouri to use a Republican-drawn congressional map that dissolves a Kansas City-based Democratic district.
segments.tr: 联邦上诉法院已命令密苏里州使用共和党绘制的国会地图,该地图解散了以堪萨斯城为基地的民主党选区。

segments.src: The order came even though ballots reflecting the older district lines had already been printed and mailed.
segments.tr: 尽管反映旧地区线路的选票已经被印刷和邮寄,该命令仍然下达。

segments.src: On Tuesday night, the dispute went back to the U.S.
segments.tr: 周二晚上,这场纠纷回到了美国

segments.src: Supreme Court, the third time in September that the justices have been asked to step in.
segments.tr: 最高法院,这是9月份法官第三次被要求介入。

segments.src: This article explains what happened, what each side argues, and what is still unsettled.
segments.tr: 本文解释了发生了什么,各方的论点以及仍未解决的问题。

segments.src: The situation is changing quickly, and details are current as of September 24, 2026.
segments.tr: 局势变化迅速,详情截至2026年9月24日为准。

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 简短版本

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **争执的焦点:** 密苏里州在2026年11月大选中使用两份国会地图中的哪一份。一份是2022年地图。另一份是共和党领导的立法机构在2025年通过的地图。

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **最直接受影响的是:** 堪萨斯城及周边地区的选民。2025年地图瓦解了民主党美国众议院代表埃曼纽尔·克利弗二世所代表的第5国会选区。

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **目前状况:** 美国第八巡回上诉法院于9月21日周一裁定必须使用2025年地图。该裁决暂停至9月28日周一,以便给最高法院时间采取行动。

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **接下来会发生什么:** 法官们可能会阻止该命令,让其生效,或在考虑该案件时延长暂停。

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## 纠纷如何发展到这一步

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: 这场争执在短时间内在州法院和联邦法院中进行。

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: 以下是新闻媒体报道的事件序列:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025年:** 密苏里州共和党人通过了一份新的国会地图,这是由唐纳德·特朗普总统支持的更广泛全国性推动的一部分,目的是以有利于共和党候选人的方式重新划分美国众议院选区。该地图重新划定了克利弗代表的堪萨斯城地区选区。

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **公投请愿:** 一个名为"人民而非政客"的组织收集了公投的签名,该公投将让选民决定新地图是否应该生效。其立场是,在选民表态之前,不能使用该地图。

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **8月4日:** 密苏里州使用2025年地图进行了政党初选。州官员辩称公投请愿尚未经过认证。

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **9月3日:** 密苏里州最高法院一致裁定,根据州法律,2025年地图在进行公投之前不能用于今年的中期选举。它指示官员使用2022年地图。

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **9月初:** 美国最高法院拒绝受理来自密苏里州官员的上诉。几小时后,圣路易斯的联邦地区法官斯蒂芬·克拉克发布了临时命令,禁止使用2025年地图以外的任何地图。几天后,最高法院暂停了他的命令,恢复了使用2022年地图的指示。

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **9月21日:** 第八巡回法院的三人法官小组支持2025年地图并下令使用。克拉克法官随后发出了相应命令,但延迟至9月28日,以便上诉可以进行。

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **周二晚间,9月22日:** "人民而非政客"要求最高法院阻止联邦命令。负责处理第八巡回法院紧急事务的法官布雷特·卡瓦诺设置了周三的回复截止日期。

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## 上诉法院为何这样裁决

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: 根据对该裁决的报道,第八巡回法院的推理围绕着关于单一选举周期内一致性的宪法论证。

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: 法院表示,选民应在与初选中使用的选区相匹配的选区选举国会议员。

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: 8月初选是在2025年地图下进行的,因此在11月改用2022年地图将使大约284,000名初选选民在大选中进入不同的选区。

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: 该小组写道:"只有使用2025年地图才符合美国宪法和联邦法律。"

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: 它还指出,在竞选期间,密苏里州人"申请参加国会竞选,见过候选人,观看了竞选广告,收到了竞选邮件,并在2025年地图下投票。"

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: 法院还讨论了珀塞尔原则。

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: 这是法院经常引用的原则,用于避免对选举规则的迟到改变,这可能会令选民和选举工作人员感到困惑。

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: 据报道,该小组将初选进行的2025年地图视为实际的现状。

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: 因此,它拒绝了认为该原则阻止其命令的论点。

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## 另一方的论点

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: "人民而非政客"和2022年地图的其他支持者的看法不同。

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: 他们指出密苏里州最高法院对该州公投程序如何运作的裁决。

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: 他们还指出,美国

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: 最高法院本月已两次采取行动,使2022年地图保持原样。

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: 该组织的执行主任理查德·冯·格拉恩辩称,在选举中途改变地图是真正的问题。

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "您不能在选举中途改变地图,"他说,对该组织的立场表示有信心。

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: 2025年地图的支持者,包括密苏里州国务卿和在新边界下竞选的共和党候选人,辩称初选结果和随后的竞选活动使2025年地图成为有效的地图。

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## 选票问题

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: 时间安排是使这个案件不同寻常的原因。

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: 11月3日选举的选票是按照2022年地区线路印刷并邮寄的,包括发给海外和军事选民的选票。

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: 缺席投票本周开始。

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: 如果实施2025年地图,选举官员将面临在非常接近选举日时重新发行或调和选票的任务。

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: 第八巡回法院自己的命令说2025年地图应该管辖,但法院和州官员都没有公开列出如果命令生效选票如何处理的完整计划。

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: 密苏里州选民也将在11月3日看到一份全州问卷,提案A,询问是否批准2025年地图。

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: "人民而非政客"正在为"否决"投票开展竞选。

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: 该组织报告称在其签名运动上花费了数百万美元,一个名为"密苏里州优先"的委员会花费资金反对它。

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## 接下来要关注的事项

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **9月28日之前的最高法院命令。** 鉴于截止日期,预期法官们要么对紧急请求进行裁决,要么延长暂停。

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **对选举官员的指导。** 地方选举机构需要清楚的说明,说明选票上出现哪些地区以及如何处理已经发出的选票。

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **更大的法律问题。** 该案件测试联邦法院应给予州最高法院对州法律解读多少重视,以及当初选和大选在不同地图下进行时"不允许迟到改变"原则的范围有多远。

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **更广泛的众议院局面。** 堪萨斯城席位是中期选举前全国争夺地区线路的几个战场之一。结果可能会影响美国众议院的平衡。

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## 密苏里州选民可以做什么

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: 由于规则仍未确定,选民应该依赖官方来源而不是社交媒体谣言:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - 通过您当地的选举机构或密苏里州国务卿网站确认您的注册和当前的国会选区。

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - 如果您已经有缺席选票,请按照随附的说明操作,并查看来自您所在县选举办公室的更新。

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - 在退回选票之前检查官方公告,因为如果法院采取行动,指导可能会改变。

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## संक्षिप्त संस्करण

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## विवाद यहां कैसे पहुंचा

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: लड़ाई कम समय में राज्य और संघीय अदालतों के माध्यम से चली गई है।

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: यहाँ समाचार आउटलेट द्वारा रिपोर्ट किया गया अनुक्रम है:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025:** मिसौरी रिपब्लिकन ने एक व्यापक राष्ट्रीय धक्का के हिस्से के रूप में एक नया कांग्रेस नक्शा पारित किया, राष्ट्रपति Donald Trump द्वारा समर्थित, यू.एस. हाउस जिलों को फिर से खींचने के लिए रिपब्लिकन उम्मीदवारों के पक्ष में। नक्शा Cleaver द्वारा प्रतिनिधित्व किए गए कैनसस सिटी-क्षेत्र जिले को फिर से आकार देता है।

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **जनमत संग्रह याचिका:** People Not Politicians नामक एक समूह ने एक जनमत संग्रह के लिए हस्ताक्षर एकत्र किए जो मतदाताओं को यह तय करने देगा कि नया नक्शा प्रभाव में आना चाहिए या नहीं। इसकी स्थिति है कि नक्शा तब तक उपयोग नहीं किया जा सकता जब तक मतदाता इसमें योगदान न दें।

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **4 अगस्त:** मिसौरी ने 2025 के नक्शे का उपयोग करके अपनी पार्टी प्राथमिकताएं आयोजित कीं। राज्य अधिकारियों ने तर्क दिया कि जनमत संग्रह याचिका को अभी तक प्रमाणित नहीं किया गया था।

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **3 सितंबर:** मिसौरी सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने सर्वसम्मति से निर्णय दिया कि, राज्य कानून के तहत, 2025 का नक्शा इस साल के मध्यकाल तक जनमत संग्रह में न जाने तक उपयोग नहीं किया जा सकता। इसने अधिकारियों को 2022 के नक्शे का उपयोग करने का निर्देश दिया।

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **सितंबर की शुरुआत में:** यू.एस. सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मिसौरी अधिकारियों से अपील स्वीकार करने से इनकार कर दिया। कुछ घंटों बाद, St. Louis में संघीय जिला न्यायाधीश, Stephen Clark, ने 2025 वाले के अलावा किसी भी नक्शे को प्रतिबंधित करने के लिए एक अस्थायी आदेश जारी किया। इसके कुछ दिन बाद, सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने उनके आदेश को रोक दिया, जिसने 2022 के नक्शे का उपयोग करने के निर्देश को बहाल किया।

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **21 सितंबर:** 8वें सर्किट के तीन-न्यायाधीश पैनल ने 2025 के नक्शे का पक्ष लिया और इसके उपयोग का आदेश दिया। Judge Clark ने फिर उसी के लिए एक आदेश जारी किया लेकिन इसे 28 सितंबर तक स्थगित कर दिया ताकि अपील आगे बढ़ सकीं।

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **मंगलवार देर से, 22 सितंबर:** People Not Politicians ने सुप्रीम कोर्ट से संघीय आदेश को अवरुद्ध करने के लिए कहा। Justice Brett Kavanaugh, जो 8वें सर्किट से आपातकालीन मामलों को संभालते हैं, ने बुधवार के लिए प्रतिक्रियाओं के लिए एक समय सीमा निर्धारित की।

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## अपील अदालत ने जिस तरह फैसला दिया उसके कारण

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: फैसले पर रिपोर्टिंग के अनुसार, 8वें सर्किट का तर्क एक एकल चुनाव चक्र के भीतर स्थिरता के बारे में एक संवैधानिक तर्क पर केंद्रित था।

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: अदालत ने कहा, मतदाताओं को कांग्रेस के सदस्यों को ऐसे जिलों में चुनना चाहिए जो प्राथमिकता में उपयोग किए गए हों।

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: अगस्त की प्राथमिकता 2025 के नक्शे के तहत आयोजित की गई थी, इसलिए नवंबर के लिए 2022 के नक्शे पर स्विच करने से सामान्य चुनाव के लिए लगभग 284,000 प्राथमिक मतदाता अलग-अलग जिलों में रखे जाएंगे।

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: पैनल ने लिखा कि "2025 के नक्शे का केवल उपयोग संविधान और संघीय कानून का अनुपालन करता है।"

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: इसने यह भी नोट किया कि अभियान के दौरान, मिसौरी के लोगों ने "कांग्रेस के लिए दौड़ के लिए दाखिल किया, उम्मीदवारों से मिले, अभियान विज्ञापन देखे, अभियान मेल प्राप्त किया, और 2025 के नक्शे के तहत मतदान किया।"

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: अदालत ने Purcell सिद्धांत को भी संबोधित किया।

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: यह एक सिद्धांत है जिसे अदालतें अक्सर चुनाव नियमों में देर से होने वाले परिवर्तन से बचने के लिए उद्धृत करती हैं जो मतदाताओं और चुनाव कर्मचारियों को भ्रमित कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: पैनल ने कथित रूप से 2025 के नक्शे को माना, जिस पर प्राथमिकता चलाई गई थी, व्यावहारिक स्थिति के रूप में।

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: इसलिए इसने इस तर्क को खारिज कर दिया कि सिद्धांत इसके आदेश को अवरुद्ध करता था।

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## दूसरी तरफ क्या कहता है

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians और 2022 के नक्शे के अन्य समर्थक इसे अलग तरीके से देखते हैं।

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: वे मिसौरी सुप्रीम कोर्ट के फैसले की ओर इशारा करते हैं कि राज्य की अपनी जनमत संग्रह प्रक्रिया कैसे काम करती है।

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: वे यह भी नोट करते हैं कि यू.एस.

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: सुप्रीम कोर्ट इस महीने पहले ही दो बार कार्य कर चुका है जो 2022 के नक्शे को जगह में रखता है।

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: समूह के कार्यकारी निदेशक, Richard von Glahn, ने तर्क दिया है कि चुनाव के बीच में नक्शा परिवर्तन वास्तविक समस्या है।

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "आप चुनाव के बीच में नक्शा नहीं बदल सकते," उन्होंने कहा, समूह की स्थिति में आत्मविश्वास व्यक्त किया।

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: 2025 के नक्शे के समर्थक, जिनमें मिसौरी के राज्य सचिव और नई लाइनों के तहत चल रहे रिपब्लिकन उम्मीदवार शामिल हैं, तर्क देते हैं कि प्राथमिक परिणाम और जो अभियान गतिविधि के बाद हुई, 2025 के नक्शे को परिचालन योग्य बनाती है।

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## मतपत्र समस्या

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: समय वह है जो इस मामले को असामान्य बनाता है।

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: नवंबर 3 के चुनाव के लिए मतपत्र 2022 जिला सीमाओं के साथ मुद्रित और भेजे गए, जिनमें विदेशी और सैन्य मतदाता शामिल हैं।

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: अनुपस्थित मतदान इस सप्ताह शुरू हुआ।

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: यदि 2025 का नक्शा लागू किया जाता है, तो चुनाव अधिकारियों को चुनाव दिवस के बहुत करीब मतपत्रों को फिर से जारी करने या सुलझाने का काम करना पड़ेगा।

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: 8वें सर्किट के अपने आदेश ने कहा कि 2025 का नक्शा शासन करना चाहिए, लेकिन न तो अदालतों और न ही राज्य अधिकारियों ने सार्वजनिक रूप से यह बताया है कि यदि आदेश प्रभाव में आता है तो मतपत्रों को कैसे संभाला जाएगा।

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: मिसौरी के मतदाता नवंबर 3 पर एक राज्यव्यापी प्रश्न, प्रस्ताव A भी देखेंगे, जो पूछता है कि 2025 के नक्शे को मंजूरी देनी है या नहीं।

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians एक "नहीं" वोट के लिए अभियान चला रहा है।

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: समूह ने अपनी हस्ताक्षर ड्राइव पर लाखों खर्च करने की रिपोर्ट की है, और Put Missouri First नामक एक समिति ने इसका विरोध करने के लिए खर्च किया है।

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या देखना है

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **28 सितंबर से पहले सुप्रीम कोर्ट का आदेश।** समय सीमा को देखते हुए, न्यायाधीशों से आपातकालीन अनुरोध पर फैसला करने या विराम को बढ़ाने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **चुनाव अधिकारियों के लिए दिशानिर्देश।** स्थानीय चुनाव अधिकारियों को स्पष्ट निर्देशों की आवश्यकता होगी कि कौन से जिले मतपत्रों पर दिखाई देते हैं और पहले से जारी किए गए मतपत्रों को कैसे संभालना है।

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **बड़ा कानूनी सवाल।** मामला परीक्षण करता है कि संघीय अदालतों को राज्य सुप्रीम कोर्ट की राज्य कानून की व्याख्या को कितना वजन देना चाहिए, और "कोई देर से परिवर्तन नहीं" सिद्धांत कितना दूर पहुंचता है जब प्राथमिकता और सामान्य चुनाव विभिन्न नक्शों के तहत आयोजित होते हैं।

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **व्यापक हाउस तस्वीर।** कैनसस सिटी की सीट मध्यकाल से पहले जिला लाइनों पर एक राष्ट्रव्यापी लड़ाई में कई युद्ध क्षेत्रों में से एक है। परिणाम यू.एस. हाउस के संतुलन को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## मिसौरी के मतदाता क्या कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: क्योंकि नियम अभी भी अनुत्तरित हैं, मतदाताओं को सोशल मीडिया अफवाहों के बजाय आधिकारिक स्रोतों पर भरोसा करना चाहिए:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - अपने स्थानीय चुनाव प्राधिकार या मिसौरी सचिव-राज्य की वेबसाइट के साथ अपने पंजीकरण और अपने वर्तमान कांग्रेस जिले की पुष्टि करें।

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - यदि आपके पास पहले से अनुपस्थित मतपत्र है, तो इसके साथ आए निर्देशों का पालन करें और अपनी काउंटी चुनाव कार्यालय से अपडेट की निगरानी करें।

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - मतपत्र लौटाने से पहले आधिकारिक घोषणाओं की जांच करें, क्योंकि यदि अदालतें कार्य करती हैं तो दिशानिर्देश बदल सकते हैं।

segments.src: *This article is a news summary based on publicly reported court filings and coverage.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सार्वजनिक रूप से रिपोर्ट किए गए अदालत फाइलिंग और कवरेज पर आधारित एक समाचार सारांश है।

segments.src: The case is ongoing and details may change.*
segments.tr: मामला चल रहा है और विवरण बदल सकते हैं।*

es.title: Papeletas ya enviadas, mapa aún en disputa: La batalla de redistribución de distritos de Misuri en la Corte Suprema

segments.src: Missouri voters are starting to receive and return ballots for the November 3 election.
segments.tr: Los votantes de Misuri están comenzando a recibir y devolver papeletas para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre.

segments.src: The congressional map those ballots are based on may not be the one that ends up being used.
segments.tr: El mapa congresional en el que se basan esas papeletas puede no ser el que se use al final.

segments.src: A federal appeals court has ordered Missouri to use a Republican-drawn congressional map that dissolves a Kansas City-based Democratic district.
segments.tr: Una corte federal de apelaciones ha ordenado a Misuri usar un mapa congresional trazado por republicanos que disuelve un distrito democrático con sede en Kansas City.

segments.src: The order came even though ballots reflecting the older district lines had already been printed and mailed.
segments.tr: La orden se emitió a pesar de que las papeletas que reflejaban las líneas de distrito más antiguas ya habían sido impresas y enviadas.

segments.src: On Tuesday night, the dispute went back to the U.S.
segments.tr: El martes por la noche, la disputa regresó a los EE.UU.

segments.src: Supreme Court, the third time in September that the justices have been asked to step in.
segments.tr: Corte Suprema, la tercera vez en septiembre que se le ha pedido a los magistrados que intervengan.

segments.src: This article explains what happened, what each side argues, and what is still unsettled.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## La versión corta

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **Qué se está disputando:** Cuál de dos mapas congresionales usa Misuri en las elecciones generales de noviembre de 2026. Uno es el mapa de 2022. El otro es un mapa aprobado por la legislatura liderada por republicanos en 2025.

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **Quién se ve afectado más directamente:** Votantes en y alrededor de Kansas City. El mapa de 2025 desmantela el Quinto Distrito Congresional, que es representado por la Rep. de EE.UU. demócrata Emanuel Cleaver II.

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **Dónde están las cosas:** La Corte de Apelaciones del Octavo Circuito de EE.UU. dictaminó el lunes 21 de septiembre que el mapa de 2025 debe usarse. Esa sentencia está suspendida hasta el lunes 28 de septiembre para dar tiempo a la Corte Suprema de actuar.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **Qué sucede después:** Los magistrados podrían bloquear la orden, permitir que entre en vigor, o extender la pausa mientras consideran el caso.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## Cómo llegó aquí la disputa

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: La batalla se ha movido a través de cortes estatales y federales en poco tiempo.

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: Aquí está la secuencia según lo reportado por los medios de comunicación:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025:** Los republicanos de Misuri aprobaron un nuevo mapa congresional como parte de un esfuerzo nacional más amplio, respaldado por el Presidente Donald Trump, para redibujar los distritos de la Cámara de Representantes de EE.UU. de maneras que favorezcan a los candidatos republicanos. El mapa remodela el distrito del área de Kansas City representado por Cleaver.

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **Petición de referéndum:** Un grupo llamado People Not Politicians recopiló firmas para un referéndum que permitiría a los votantes decidir si el nuevo mapa debe entrar en vigor. Su posición es que el mapa no puede usarse hasta que los votantes se pronuncien.

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **4 de agosto:** Misuri celebró sus primarias partidarias usando el mapa de 2025. Los funcionarios estatales argumentaron que la petición de referéndum aún no había sido certificada.

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **3 de septiembre:** La Corte Suprema de Misuri dictaminó unánimemente que, conforme a la ley estatal, el mapa de 2025 no podía usarse en las elecciones de mitad de período de este año hasta que fuera a un referéndum. Ordenó a los funcionarios que usaran el mapa de 2022.

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **Principios de septiembre:** La Corte Suprema de EE.UU. se negó a considerar una apelación de funcionarios de Misuri. Horas después, un juez de distrito federal en St. Louis, Stephen Clark, emitió una orden temporal prohibiendo cualquier mapa que no fuera el de 2025. Unos días después, la Corte Suprema anuló su orden, lo que restauró la instrucción de usar el mapa de 2022.

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **21 de septiembre:** Un panel de tres jueces del Octavo Circuito se alineó con el mapa de 2025 y ordenó su uso. El juez Clark luego emitió una orden en ese sentido pero la retrasó hasta el 28 de septiembre para que las apelaciones pudieran proceder.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **Tarde del martes, 22 de septiembre:** People Not Politicians le pidió a la Corte Suprema que bloqueara la orden federal. El Juez Brett Kavanaugh, quien maneja asuntos de emergencia del Octavo Circuito, estableció una fecha límite para respuestas el miércoles.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## Por qué la corte de apelaciones dictaminó de la manera en que lo hizo

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: Según los reportes sobre la decisión, el razonamiento del Octavo Circuito se basó en un argumento constitucional sobre la consistencia dentro de un solo ciclo electoral.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: Los votantes, dijo la corte, deberían elegir miembros del Congreso en distritos que coincidan con los utilizados en las primarias.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: Las primarias de agosto se celebraron bajo el mapa de 2025, por lo que cambiar al mapa de 2022 para noviembre colocaría aproximadamente 284.000 votantes de las primarias en distritos diferentes para las elecciones generales.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: El panel escribió que "solo el uso del mapa de 2025 cumple con la Constitución y la ley federal."

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: También señaló que durante la campaña, los ciudadanos de Misuri "presentaron candidaturas para el Congreso, se reunieron con candidatos, vieron anuncios de campaña, recibieron correo de campaña, y votaron bajo el mapa de 2025."

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: La corte también abordó el principio de Purcell.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: Esta es una doctrina que las cortes a menudo citan para evitar cambios tardíos en las reglas electorales que podrían confundir a los votantes y trabajadores electorales.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: Al parecer, el panel trató el mapa de 2025, sobre el cual se ejecutaron las primarias, como el statu quo práctico.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, rechazó el argumento de que la doctrina bloqueaba su orden.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## Qué dice el otro lado

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians y otros partidarios del mapa de 2022 lo ven de manera diferente.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: Señalan la sentencia de la Corte Suprema de Misuri sobre cómo funciona el propio proceso de referéndum del estado.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: También señalan que los EE.UU.

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: Corte Suprema ya ha actuado dos veces este mes de formas que dejaron el mapa de 2022 en vigor.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: El director ejecutivo del grupo, Richard von Glahn, ha argumentado que los cambios de mapa en medio de unas elecciones son el problema real.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "No se pueden cambiar los mapas en medio de unas elecciones," dijo, expresando confianza en la posición del grupo.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: Los partidarios del mapa de 2025, incluido el secretario de estado de Misuri y los candidatos republicanos que se postularon bajo las nuevas líneas, argumentan que los resultados de las primarias y la actividad de campaña que siguieron hacen que el mapa de 2025 sea el operativo.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## El problema de la papeleta

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: El tiempo es lo que hace que este caso sea inusual.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: Las papeletas para las elecciones del 3 de noviembre se imprimieron con las líneas de distrito de 2022 y se enviaron, incluyendo a votantes en el extranjero y militares.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: La votación por ausencia comenzó esta semana.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: Si se impone el mapa de 2025, los funcionarios electorales enfrentarían la tarea de reedivar o reconciliar papeletas muy cerca del día de las elecciones.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: La propia orden del Octavo Circuito dijo que el mapa de 2025 debería gobernar, pero ni las cortes ni los funcionarios estatales han presentado públicamente un plan completo sobre cómo se manejarían las papeletas si la orden entra en vigor.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: Los votantes de Misuri también verán una pregunta estatal el 3 de noviembre, Proposición A, que pregunta si se debe aprobar el mapa de 2025.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians está haciendo campaña por un voto "no".

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: El grupo ha reportado gastar millones en su campaña de recolección de firmas, y un comité llamado Put Missouri First ha invertido para oponerla.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Qué ver a continuación

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **Una orden de la Corte Suprema antes del 28 de septiembre.** Dada la fecha límite, se espera que los magistrados se pronuncien sobre la solicitud de emergencia o extiendan la pausa.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **Orientación para funcionarios electorales.** Las autoridades electorales locales necesitarán instrucciones claras sobre qué distritos aparecen en las papeletas y cómo manejar las papeletas ya emitidas.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **La cuestión jurídica más amplia.** El caso prueba cuánto peso deben dar los tribunales federales a la lectura de la ley estatal de una corte suprema estatal, y qué tan lejos llega el principio de "sin cambios tardíos" cuando una elección primaria y general se celebran bajo mapas diferentes.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **El panorama más amplio de la Cámara.** El escaño de Kansas City es uno de varios campos de batalla en una lucha nacional sobre líneas de distrito antes de las elecciones de mitad de período. El resultado podría afectar el equilibrio de la Cámara de Representantes de EE.UU.

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## Qué pueden hacer los votantes de Misuri

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: Porque las reglas aún están en duda, los votantes deben confiar en fuentes oficiales en lugar de rumores de redes sociales:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - Confirme su registro y su distrito congresional actual con su autoridad electoral local o el sitio web del Secretario de Estado de Misuri.

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - Si ya tiene una papeleta por ausencia, siga las instrucciones que vinieron con ella y esté atento a actualizaciones de su oficina electoral del condado.

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - Verifique los anuncios oficiales antes de devolver una papeleta, ya que la orientación podría cambiar si las cortes actúan.

segments.tr: تمت الانتخابات الأولية في أغسطس تحت خريطة 2025، لذا فإن الانتقال إلى خريطة 2022 لشهر نوفمبر سيضع حوالي 284,000 ناخب من الانتخابات الأولية في دوائر مختلفة للانتخابات العامة.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: كتبت الهيئة أن "استخدام خريطة 2025 فقط يتوافق مع الدستور والقانون الفيدرالي."

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: كما لاحظت أنه خلال الحملة، "تقدم سكان ميسوري لمنصب الكونجرس، والتقوا المرشحين، ومشاهدة إعلانات الحملة، واستقبلوا رسائل الحملة، والتصويت تحت خريطة 2025."

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: تناولت المحكمة أيضاً مبدأ بوسيل.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: هذا هو المبدأ الذي تستشهد به المحاكم غالباً لتجنب التغييرات المتأخرة في قواعد الانتخابات التي قد تربك الناخبين والعاملين في الانتخابات.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: يُقال إن الهيئة اعتبرت خريطة 2025، التي أُجريت عليها الانتخابات الأولية، بمثابة الوضع الراهن العملي.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: وبالتالي رفضت الحجة القائلة بأن المبدأ يحجب أمرها.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## ما يقول الجانب الآخر

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: ترى مجموعة People Not Politicians وغيرها من مؤيدي خريطة 2022 الأمر بشكل مختلف.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: يشيرون إلى حكم المحكمة العليا في ميسوري حول كيفية عمل عملية الاستفتاء الخاصة بالدولة.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: كما يلاحظون أن الولايات المتحدة

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: المحكمة العليا قد تصرفت بالفعل مرتين هذا الشهر بطرق أبقت على خريطة 2022 في مكانها.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: يجادل المدير التنفيذي للمجموعة، ريتشارد فون جلان، بأن تغييرات الخريطة في منتصف الانتخابات هي المشكلة الحقيقية.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "لا يمكنك تغيير الخرائط في منتصف الانتخابات،" قال، معبراً عن ثقته في موقف المجموعة.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: يجادل مؤيدو خريطة 2025، بما في ذلك سكرتير الدولة في ميسوري والمرشحون الجمهوريون الذين يترشحون تحت الخطوط الجديدة، بأن نتائج الانتخابات الأولية والنشاط الانتخابي الذي تلاها تجعل خريطة 2025 هي الخريطة الفعلية.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## مشكلة الأصوات

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: التوقيت هو ما يجعل هذه القضية غير عادية.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: تمت طباعة الأصوات للانتخابات في 3 نوفمبر بخطوط الدوائر 2022 وإرسالها، بما في ذلك للناخبين في الخارج والعسكريين.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: بدأ التصويت الغيابي هذا الأسبوع.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: إذا تمت فرض خريطة 2025، ستواجه السلطات الانتخابية مهمة إعادة إصدار أو التوفيق بين الأصوات في فترة قريبة جداً من يوم الانتخابات.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: قالت الأمر الخاص بالدائرة الثامنة أن خريطة 2025 يجب أن تحكم، لكن لا المحاكم ولا المسؤولين الحكوميين أبرزوا علانية خطة شاملة لكيفية التعامل مع الأصوات إذا دخل الأمر حيز التنفيذ.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: سيرى ناخبو ميسوري أيضاً سؤالاً على مستوى الولاية في 3 نوفمبر، الاقتراح أ، الذي يسأل عما إذا كان يجب الموافقة على خريطة 2025.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: تقوم مجموعة People Not Politicians بحملة للتصويت ب "لا".

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: أفادت المجموعة بإنفاق ملايين على حملة التوقيعات الخاصة بها، وأنفقت لجنة تدعى Put Missouri First للمعارضة.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته بعد ذلك

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **أمر من المحكمة العليا قبل 28 سبتمبر.** نظراً للموعد النهائي، يُتوقع من القضاة إما أن يحكموا على طلب الطوارئ أو تمديد الإيقاف المؤقت.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **التوجيه لمسؤولي الانتخابات.** ستحتاج السلطات الانتخابية المحلية إلى تعليمات واضحة حول الدوائر التي تظهر على الأصوات وكيفية التعامل مع الأصوات المُصدرة بالفعل.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **السؤال القانوني الأوسع.** تختبر القضية مقدار الوزن الذي يجب أن تعطيه المحاكم الفيدرالية لقراءة المحكمة العليا في الولاية للقانون الولائي، ومدى وصول مبدأ "عدم التغييرات المتأخرة" عندما تُجرى الانتخابات الأولية والانتخابات العامة تحت خرائط مختلفة.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **الصورة الأوسع لمجلس النواب.** مقعد كانساس سيتي هو أحد عدة ساحات معارك في صراع وطني على خطوط الدوائر قبل انتخابات التجديد النصفي. قد تؤثر النتيجة على توازن مجلس النواب الأمريكي.

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## ما يمكن لناخبي ميسوري فعله

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: لأن القواعد لا تزال معلقة، يجب على الناخبين الاعتماد على مصادر رسمية بدلاً من شائعات وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - تأكد من تسجيلك والدائرة الانتخابية الحالية مع سلطات الانتخابات المحلية أو موقع وزير الدولة في ميسوري.

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - إذا كان لديك بالفعل ورقة تصويت غيابية، اتبع التعليمات التي جاءت معها وراقب التحديثات من مكتب الانتخابات في المقاطعة.

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - تحقق من الإعلانات الرسمية قبل إرجاع ورقة تصويت، لأن التوجيه قد يتغير إذا تصرفت المحاكم.

fr.title: Les bulletins déjà expédiés, la carte toujours contestée : le combat de redécoupage du Missouri devant la Cour suprême

segments.src: Missouri voters are starting to receive and return ballots for the November 3 election.
segments.tr: Les électeurs du Missouri commencent à recevoir et à retourner leurs bulletins de vote pour l'élection du 3 novembre.

segments.src: The congressional map those ballots are based on may not be the one that ends up being used.
segments.tr: La carte électorale sur laquelle ces bulletins sont basés n'est peut-être pas celle qui sera finalement utilisée.

segments.src: A federal appeals court has ordered Missouri to use a Republican-drawn congressional map that dissolves a Kansas City-based Democratic district.
segments.tr: Une cour d'appel fédérale a ordonné au Missouri d'utiliser une carte électorale tracée par les Républicains qui dissout un district démocrate basé à Kansas City.

segments.src: The order came even though ballots reflecting the older district lines had already been printed and mailed.
segments.tr: L'ordonnance est venue alors que des bulletins reflétant les anciennes lignes de district avaient déjà été imprimés et envoyés.

segments.src: On Tuesday night, the dispute went back to the U.S.
segments.tr: Mardi soir, l'affaire est retournée aux États-Unis.

segments.src: Supreme Court, the third time in September that the justices have been asked to step in.
segments.tr: Cour suprême, la troisième fois en septembre que les juges ont été invités à intervenir.

segments.src: This article explains what happened, what each side argues, and what is still unsettled.
segments.tr: Cet article explique ce qui s'est passé, ce que chaque partie soutient et ce qui reste non résolu.

segments.src: The situation is changing quickly, and details are current as of September 24, 2026.
segments.tr: La situation évolue rapidement et les détails sont à jour au 24 septembre 2026.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## La version courte

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **Ce qui est en cause :** Quelle carte électorale parmi deux le Missouri utilisera pour l'élection générale de novembre 2026. L'une est la carte de 2022. L'autre est une carte adoptée par la législature dirigée par les Républicains en 2025.

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **Qui est le plus directement affecté :** Les électeurs dans et autour de Kansas City. La carte de 2025 démantèle le 5e district du Congrès, que détient le représentant démocrate américain Emanuel Cleaver II.

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **L'état actuel :** La 8e Cour d'appel des États-Unis a statué lundi 21 septembre que la carte de 2025 doit être utilisée. Ce jugement est suspendu jusqu'à lundi 28 septembre pour donner à la Cour suprême le temps d'agir.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **Ce qui se passe ensuite :** Les juges pourraient bloquer l'ordonnance, la laisser entrer en vigueur ou prolonger la pause pendant qu'ils examinent l'affaire.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## Comment cette affaire en est arrivée là

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: L'affaire a traversé les tribunaux d'État et fédéraux en peu de temps.

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: Voici la chronologie telle que rapportée par les médias :

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025 :** Les Républicains du Missouri ont adopté une nouvelle carte électorale dans le cadre d'une poussée nationale plus large, soutenue par le président Donald Trump, pour redessiner les districts de la Chambre des États-Unis d'une manière favorable aux candidats républicains. La carte remodèle le district de la région de Kansas City représenté par Cleaver.

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **Pétition pour un référendum :** Un groupe appelé People Not Politicians a rassemblé des signatures pour un référendum qui permettrait aux électeurs de décider si la nouvelle carte devrait entrer en vigueur. Sa position est que la carte ne peut pas être utilisée jusqu'à ce que les électeurs se prononcent.

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **4 août :** Le Missouri a tenu ses primaires de parti en utilisant la carte de 2025. Les responsables d'État ont soutenu que la pétition pour un référendum n'avait pas encore été certifiée.

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **3 septembre :** La Cour suprême du Missouri a statué à l'unanimité que, selon la loi d'État, la carte de 2025 ne pourrait pas être utilisée dans les élections de mi-mandat de cette année jusqu'à ce qu'elle aille à un référendum. Elle a ordonné aux autorités d'utiliser la carte de 2022.

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **Début septembre :** La Cour suprême des États-Unis a rejeté un appel des responsables du Missouri. Quelques heures plus tard, un juge de district fédéral à Saint-Louis, Stephen Clark, a émis une ordonnance temporaire interdisant toute carte autre que celle de 2025. Quelques jours après, la Cour suprême a suspendu son ordonnance, ce qui a rétabli l'instruction d'utiliser la carte de 2022.

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **21 septembre :** Un panel de trois juges du 8e circuit s'est prononcé en faveur de la carte de 2025 et a ordonné son utilisation. Le juge Clark a alors émis une ordonnance à cet effet mais l'a reportée jusqu'au 28 septembre pour que les appels puissent procéder.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **Mardi soir, 22 septembre :** People Not Politicians a demandé à la Cour suprême de bloquer l'ordonnance fédérale. Le juge Brett Kavanaugh, qui traite les affaires d'urgence du 8e circuit, a fixé une date limite pour les réponses mercredi.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la cour d'appel a statué ainsi

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: Selon le reportage sur la décision, le raisonnement du 8e circuit a porté sur un argument constitutionnel concernant la cohérence au sein d'un seul cycle électoral.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: Les électeurs, a dit la cour, devraient élire des membres du Congrès dans des districts qui correspondent à ceux utilisés dans la primaire.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: La primaire d'août a été tenue selon la carte de 2025, donc passer à la carte de 2022 pour novembre placerait environ 284 000 électeurs de primaire dans des districts différents pour l'élection générale.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: Le panel a écrit que « seul l'usage de la carte de 2025 est conforme à la Constitution et à la loi fédérale. »

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: Il a également noté que pendant la campagne, les Missouriens « ont déposé leur candidature au Congrès, ont rencontré des candidats, ont regardé des publicités de campagne, ont reçu du courrier de campagne et ont voté selon la carte de 2025. »

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: La cour a également abordé le principe de Purcell.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: C'est une doctrine que les tribunaux citent souvent pour éviter les modifications tardives des règles électorales qui pourraient confondre les électeurs et le personnel électoral.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: Le panel a apparemment traité la carte de 2025, sur laquelle la primaire a été menée, comme le statu quo pratique.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: Il a donc rejeté l'argument selon lequel la doctrine bloquait son ordonnance.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## Ce que dit l'autre côté

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians et d'autres partisans de la carte de 2022 la voient différemment.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: Ils se réfèrent à la décision de la Cour suprême du Missouri sur le fonctionnement du processus de référendum de l'État.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: Ils notent également que la Cour suprême américaine.

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: a déjà agi deux fois ce mois-ci d'une manière qui a laissé la carte de 2022 en place.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: Le directeur général du groupe, Richard von Glahn, a soutenu que les changements de carte au milieu d'une élection sont le véritable problème.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: « Vous ne pouvez pas changer les cartes au milieu d'une élection », a-t-il dit, exprimant sa confiance dans la position du groupe.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: Les partisans de la carte de 2025, y compris le secrétaire d'État du Missouri et les candidats républicains se présentant selon les nouvelles lignes, soutiennent que les résultats des primaires et l'activité de campagne qui a suivi font de la carte de 2025 celle qui est en vigueur.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## Le problème des bulletins

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: C'est le moment qui rend cette affaire inhabituelle.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: Les bulletins de vote pour l'élection du 3 novembre ont été imprimés avec les lignes de district de 2022 et envoyés par la poste, y compris aux électeurs d'outre-mer et militaires.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: Le scrutin par absence a commencé cette semaine.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: Si la carte de 2025 est imposée, les responsables électoraux devraient réémettre ou réconcilier les bulletins très près du jour de l'élection.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: L'ordonnance du 8e circuit elle-même a dit que la carte de 2025 devrait gouverner, mais ni les tribunaux ni les autorités de l'État n'ont publiquement établi un plan complet pour la gestion des bulletins si l'ordonnance entre en vigueur.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: Les électeurs du Missouri verront également une question à l'échelle de l'État le 3 novembre, la Proposition A, qui demande s'il faut approuver la carte de 2025.

segments.tr: People Not Politicians fait campagne pour un vote « non ».

segments.tr: Le groupe a signalé avoir dépensé des millions dans sa collecte de signatures, et un comité appelé Put Missouri First a dépensé pour s'y opposer.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## À surveiller ensuite

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **Une ordonnance de la Cour suprême avant le 28 septembre.** Vu la date limite, les juges devraient soit statuer sur la demande d'urgence, soit prolonger la pause.
