pt.title: Cédulas Já Enviadas, Mapa Ainda em Disputa: Dentro da Luta de Redistricting do Missouri na Suprema Corte

segments.src: Missouri voters are starting to receive and return ballots for the November 3 election.
segments.tr: Os eleitores do Missouri estão começando a receber e devolver cédulas para a eleição de 3 de novembro.

segments.src: The congressional map those ballots are based on may not be the one that ends up being used.
segments.tr: O mapa congressional em que essas cédulas são baseadas pode não ser o que acaba sendo usado.

segments.src: A federal appeals court has ordered Missouri to use a Republican-drawn congressional map that dissolves a Kansas City-based Democratic district.
segments.tr: Um tribunal federal de apelações ordenou que o Missouri use um mapa congressional desenhado pelos republicanos que dissolve um distrito democrático baseado em Kansas City.

segments.src: The order came even though ballots reflecting the older district lines had already been printed and mailed.
segments.tr: A ordem foi dada mesmo que as cédulas refletindo as antigas linhas do distrito já tivessem sido impressas e enviadas.

segments.src: On Tuesday night, the dispute went back to the U.S.
segments.tr: Na noite de terça-feira, a disputa voltou para a Suprema Corte dos EUA.

segments.src: Supreme Court, the third time in September that the justices have been asked to step in.
segments.tr: a terceira vez em setembro que os juízes foram solicitados a intervir.

segments.src: This article explains what happened, what each side argues, and what is still unsettled.
segments.tr: Este artigo explica o que aconteceu, o que cada lado argumenta e o que ainda está pendente.

segments.src: The situation is changing quickly, and details are current as of September 24, 2026.
segments.tr: A situação está mudando rapidamente, e os detalhes são atuais em 24 de setembro de 2026.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## A versão curta

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **O que está sendo disputado:** Qual dos dois mapas congressional o Missouri usa na eleição geral de novembro de 2026. Um é o mapa de 2022. O outro é um mapa aprovado pela legislatura liderada pelos republicanos em 2025.

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **Quem é afetado mais diretamente:** Eleitores em e ao redor de Kansas City. O mapa de 2025 desmantelará o 5º Distrito Congressional, que o representante democrático dos EUA, Emanuel Cleaver II, ocupa.

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **Onde as coisas estão:** O 8º Tribunal de Apelações dos EUA decidiu na segunda-feira, 21 de setembro, que o mapa de 2025 deve ser usado. Essa decisão é pausada até segunda-feira, 28 de setembro, para dar tempo à Suprema Corte de agir.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **O que acontece a seguir:** Os juízes poderiam bloquear a ordem, deixar que ela entre em vigor ou estender a pausa enquanto considerarem o caso.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## Como a disputa chegou aqui

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: A luta passou por tribunais estaduais e federais em um curto período.

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: Aqui está a sequência conforme relatado pelos meios de comunicação:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025:** Os republicanos do Missouri aprovaram um novo mapa congressional como parte de um esforço nacional mais amplo, apoiado pelo Presidente Donald Trump, para redesenhar distritos da Câmara dos EUA de forma que favoreça candidatos republicanos. O mapa reformula o distrito da área de Kansas City representado por Cleaver.

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **Petição de referendo:** Um grupo chamado People Not Politicians reuniu assinaturas para um referendo que deixaria os eleitores decidirem se o novo mapa deveria entrar em vigor. Sua posição é que o mapa não pode ser usado até que os eleitores se pronunciem.

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **4 de agosto:** Missouri realizou suas primárias do partido usando o mapa de 2025. Autoridades estaduais argumentaram que a petição de referendo ainda não havia sido certificada.

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **3 de setembro:** A Suprema Corte do Missouri decidiu por unanimidade que, de acordo com a lei estadual, o mapa de 2025 não poderia ser usado nas eleições de meio de mandato deste ano até ir a um referendo. Ela ordenou aos funcionários que usassem o mapa de 2022.

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **Início de setembro:** A Suprema Corte dos EUA recusou-se a receber um recurso de autoridades do Missouri. Horas depois, um juiz distrital federal em St. Louis, Stephen Clark, emitiu uma ordem temporária proibindo qualquer mapa que não fosse o de 2025. Alguns dias depois disso, a Suprema Corte suspendeu sua ordem, o que restaurou a instrução para usar o mapa de 2022.

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **21 de setembro:** Um painel de três juízes do 8º Circuito apoiou o mapa de 2025 e ordenou seu uso. O Juiz Clark então emitiu uma ordem nesse sentido, mas a adiou até 28 de setembro para que os recursos pudessem prosseguir.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **Tarde de terça-feira, 22 de setembro:** People Not Politicians pediu à Suprema Corte que bloqueasse a ordem federal. O Ministro Brett Kavanaugh, que cuida de assuntos de emergência do 8º Circuito, estabeleceu um prazo para respostas na quarta-feira.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## Por que o tribunal de apelações decidiu da maneira que decidiu

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: De acordo com a cobertura da decisão, o raciocínio do 8º Circuito se baseou em um argumento constitucional sobre consistência dentro de um único ciclo eleitoral.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: Os eleitores, disse o tribunal, devem eleger membros do Congresso em distritos que correspondam aos usados na primária.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: A primária de agosto foi realizada sob o mapa de 2025, então mudar para o mapa de 2022 em novembro colocaria aproximadamente 284.000 eleitores das primárias em diferentes distritos para a eleição geral.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: O painel escreveu que "apenas o uso do mapa de 2025 está em conformidade com a Constituição e a lei federal."

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: Também observou que durante a campanha, os habitantes do Missouri "se registraram para concorrer ao Congresso, conheceram candidatos, assistiram a anúncios de campanha, receberam correspondência de campanha e votaram sob o mapa de 2025."

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: O tribunal também abordou o princípio de Purcell.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: Esta é uma doutrina que os tribunais frequentemente citam para evitar mudanças tardias nas regras eleitorais que poderiam confundir eleitores e funcionários eleitorais.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: Segundo relatos, o painel tratou o mapa de 2025, no qual a primária foi realizada, como o status quo prático.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: Portanto, rejeitou o argumento de que a doutrina bloqueava sua ordem.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## O que o outro lado diz

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians e outros apoiadores do mapa de 2022 veem diferentemente.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: Eles apontam para a decisão da Suprema Corte do Missouri sobre como funciona o próprio processo de referendo do estado.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: Eles também observam que a Suprema Corte dos EUA

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: já agiu duas vezes este mês de maneiras que deixaram o mapa de 2022 em vigor.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: O diretor executivo do grupo, Richard von Glahn, argumentou que mudanças de mapa no meio de uma eleição são o verdadeiro problema.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "Você não pode mudar mapas no meio de uma eleição", disse ele, expressando confiança na posição do grupo.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: Apoiadores do mapa de 2025, incluindo a secretária de estado do Missouri e candidatos republicanos concorrendo sob as novas linhas, argumentam que os resultados das primárias e a atividade de campanha que se seguiu tornam o mapa de 2025 o operacional.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## O problema da cédula

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: O momento é o que torna este caso incomum.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: As cédulas para a eleição de 3 de novembro foram impressas com as linhas do distrito de 2022 e enviadas, incluindo para eleitores no exterior e militares.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: A votação por ausência começou esta semana.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: Se o mapa de 2025 for imposto, os funcionários eleitorais enfrentariam a tarefa de reemitir ou reconciliar cédulas muito perto do Dia da Eleição.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: A própria ordem do 8º Circuito disse que o mapa de 2025 deveria governar, mas nem os tribunais nem funcionários estaduais elaboraram publicamente um plano completo para como as cédulas seriam tratadas se a ordem entrasse em vigor.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: Os eleitores do Missouri também verão uma questão estadual em 3 de novembro, Proposição A, que pergunta se aprovam o mapa de 2025.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians está fazendo campanha para um voto "não".

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: O grupo informou ter gasto milhões em sua campanha de assinaturas, e um comitê chamado Put Missouri First gastou para se opor a ela.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## O que observar a seguir

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **Uma ordem da Suprema Corte antes de 28 de setembro.** Dado o prazo, espera-se que os juízes decidam sobre o pedido de emergência ou estendam a pausa.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **Orientação para funcionários eleitorais.** As autoridades eleitorais locais precisarão de instruções claras sobre quais distritos aparecem nas cédulas e como lidar com cédulas já emitidas.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **A questão legal maior.** O caso testa quanto peso os tribunais federais devem dar à interpretação de um tribunal supremo estadual da lei estadual, e até que ponto o princípio "sem mudanças tardias" chega quando uma primária e eleição geral são realizadas sob mapas diferentes.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **O quadro mais amplo da Câmara.** O assento de Kansas City é um dos vários campos de batalha em uma luta nacional sobre linhas de distrito antes das eleições de meio de mandato. O resultado poderia afetar o equilíbrio da Câmara dos EUA.

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## O que os eleitores do Missouri podem fazer

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: Como as regras ainda estão pendentes, os eleitores devem confiar em fontes oficiais em vez de rumores de redes sociais:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - Confirme seu registro e seu distrito congressional atual com sua autoridade eleitoral local ou no site da Secretária de Estado do Missouri.

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - Se você já tem uma cédula por ausência, siga as instruções que vieram com ela e observe as atualizações do seu escritório eleitoral do condado.

segments.tr: - Verifique os anúncios oficiais antes de devolver uma cédula, pois a orientação pode mudar se os tribunais agirem.

segments.tr: - **21 September:** Panel tiga hakim dari Sirkuit ke-8 berpihak pada peta 2025 dan memerintahkan penggunaannya. Hakim Clark kemudian mengeluarkan perintah untuk itu tetapi menundanya hingga 28 September agar banding dapat diproses.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **Akhir Selasa, 22 September:** People Not Politicians meminta Pengadilan Tertinggi untuk memblokir perintah federal. Hakim Agung Brett Kavanaugh, yang menangani masalah darurat dari Sirkuit ke-8, menetapkan batas waktu tanggapan pada hari Rabu.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## Mengapa pengadilan banding memutuskan seperti itu

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: Menurut pelaporan tentang keputusan, penalaran Sirkuit ke-8 berpusat pada argumen konstitusional tentang konsistensi dalam satu siklus pemilihan.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: Pemilih, kata pengadilan, harus memilih anggota Kongres di distrik yang sesuai dengan yang digunakan dalam pemilihan utama.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: Pemilihan utama Agustus diadakan di bawah peta 2025, jadi beralih ke peta 2022 untuk November akan menempatkan kira-kira 284.000 pemilih utama di distrik berbeda untuk pemilihan umum.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: Panel menulis bahwa "hanya penggunaan peta 2025 yang mematuhi Konstitusi dan hukum federal."

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: Panel juga mencatat bahwa selama kampanye, warga Missouri "mendaftar untuk mencalonkan diri ke Kongres, bertemu calon, menonton iklan kampanye, menerima surat kampanye, dan memilih di bawah peta 2025."

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: Pengadilan juga membahas prinsip Purcell.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: Ini adalah doktrin yang sering dikutip pengadilan untuk menghindari perubahan terlambat pada aturan pemilihan yang dapat membingungkan pemilih dan pekerja pemilihan.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: Panel dilaporkan memperlakukan peta 2025, yang digunakan pemilihan utama, sebagai status quo praktis.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: Oleh karena itu, panel menolak argumen bahwa doktrin memblokir perintahnya.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## Apa kata pihak lain

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians dan pendukung lain dari peta 2022 melihatnya berbeda.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: Mereka menunjuk pada putusan Pengadilan Tertinggi Missouri tentang bagaimana proses referendum negara bagian sendiri bekerja.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: Mereka juga mencatat bahwa A.S.

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: Pengadilan Tertinggi telah bertindak dua kali bulan ini dengan cara yang meninggalkan peta 2022 pada tempatnya.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: Direktur eksekutif kelompok, Richard von Glahn, telah berpendapat bahwa perubahan peta di tengah pemilihan adalah masalah sebenarnya.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "Anda tidak dapat mengubah peta di tengah pemilihan," katanya, mengekspresikan kepercayaan diri pada posisi kelompok.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: Pendukung peta 2025, termasuk sekretaris negara bagian Missouri dan kandidat Republik yang menjalankan di bawah garis baru, berpendapat bahwa hasil pemilihan utama dan aktivitas kampanye yang mengikuti membuat peta 2025 menjadi yang berlaku.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## Masalah surat suara

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: Waktunya adalah apa yang membuat kasus ini tidak biasa.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: Surat suara untuk pemilihan 3 November dicetak dengan garis distrik 2022 dan dikirim, termasuk kepada pemilih luar negeri dan militer.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara tidak hadir dimulai minggu ini.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: Jika peta 2025 diberlakukan, pejabat pemilihan akan menghadapi tugas mengeluarkan kembali atau merekonsiliasi surat suara sangat dekat dengan Hari Pemilihan.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: Perintah Sirkuit ke-8 sendiri mengatakan peta 2025 harus menguasai, tetapi tidak ada pengadilan maupun pejabat negara bagian yang telah menguraikan rencana lengkap untuk cara surat suara akan ditangani jika perintah berlaku.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: Pemilih Missouri juga akan melihat pertanyaan statewide pada 3 November, Proposisi A, yang menanyakan apakah perlu menyetujui peta 2025.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians sedang berkampanye untuk suara "tidak".

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: Kelompok telah melaporkan pengeluaran jutaan pada kampanye tanda tangannya, dan komite bernama Put Missouri First telah mengeluarkan untuk menentangnya.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang harus diperhatikan selanjutnya

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **Perintah Pengadilan Tertinggi sebelum 28 September.** Mengingat batas waktu, para hakim diharapkan baik untuk memutuskan permintaan darurat atau memperpanjang penundaan.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **Panduan untuk pejabat pemilihan.** Otoritas pemilihan lokal akan membutuhkan instruksi jelas tentang distrik mana yang muncul di surat suara dan cara menangani surat suara yang sudah dikeluarkan.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **Pertanyaan hukum yang lebih besar.** Kasus menguji berapa banyak bobot yang harus diberikan pengadilan federal kepada pembacaan pengadilan tertinggi negara bagian tentang hukum negara bagian, dan seberapa jauh prinsip "tidak ada perubahan terlambat" menjangkau ketika pemilihan utama dan umum diadakan di bawah peta berbeda.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **Gambaran Dewan yang lebih luas.** Kursi Kansas City adalah salah satu dari beberapa medan pertempuran dalam pertarungan nasional atas garis distrik menjelang pemilihan setengah jalan. Hasilnya dapat mempengaruhi keseimbangan Dewan Perwakilan A.S.

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang dapat dilakukan pemilih Missouri

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: Karena aturannya masih belum terselesaikan, pemilih harus mengandalkan sumber resmi daripada rumor media sosial:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - Konfirmasi pendaftaran Anda dan distrik kongres Anda saat ini dengan otoritas pemilihan lokal atau situs web Sekretaris Negara Bagian Missouri.

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - Jika Anda sudah memiliki surat suara tidak hadir, ikuti instruksi yang disertakan dan perhatikan pembaruan dari kantor pemilihan kabupaten Anda.

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - Periksa pengumuman resmi sebelum mengembalikan surat suara, karena panduan dapat berubah jika pengadilan bertindak.

segments.src: This article explains what happened, what each side argues, and what is still unsettled.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## 要約

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **何が争われているのか：** 2026年11月の総選挙でミズーリ州が使用する2つの議会地図のうちどちらか。1つは2022年の地図です。もう1つは2025年に共和党主導の議会で可決された地図です。

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **最も直接的に影響を受ける人々：** カンザスシティとその周辺の有権者。2025年の地図は、民主党のエマニュエル・クリーバーII下院議員が保有する第5議会地区を廃止します。

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **現在の状況：** 9月21日月曜日、第8米国控訴裁判所は2025年の地図を使用する必要があると裁定しました。その裁定は9月28日月曜日まで一時停止されており、最高裁に行動を起こす時間を与えています。

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **次に何が起こるか：** 裁判官は命令をブロックするか、それを効力を持たせるか、またはケースを検討している間、一時停止を延長することができます。

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## 紛争がここに至った経緯

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: 争いは短期間で州および連邦裁判所を通じて進みました。

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: ここがニュースアウトレットによって報告されたシーケンスです：

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025年：** ミズーリ州の共和党員は、ドナルド・トランプ大統領に支持された、共和党の候補者に有利な方法でアメリカ下院地区を再描画する、より広い国家的な取り組みの一部として、新しい議会地図を可決しました。この地図は、クリーバーが代表するカンザスシティエリア地区を変更します。

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **国民投票請願書：** People Not Politiciansと呼ばれるグループは、有権者が新しい地図が効力を持つべきかどうかを決定することができる国民投票のための署名を集めました。その立場は、有権者が判断するまで、地図は使用できないというものです。

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **8月4日：** ミズーリ州は2025年の地図を使用して党予備選を開催しました。州当局は、国民投票請願がまだ認定されていないと主張しました。

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **9月3日：** ミズーリ州最高裁判所は、州法に基づいて、2025年の地図は国民投票に至るまで今年の中間選挙では使用できないと満場一致で裁定しました。2022年の地図を使用するよう当局に指示しました。

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **9月初旬：** アメリカ最高裁判所はミズーリ州当局からの控訴を受け付けることを拒否しました。数時間後、セントルイスの連邦地方裁判官ステファン・クラークは、2025年のもの以外のいかなる地図も禁止する一時命令を発行しました。その数日後、最高裁判所は彼の命令を留保し、2022年の地図を使用する指示を復元しました。

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **9月21日：** 第8控訴裁判所の3人の裁判官パネルは2025年の地図を支持し、その使用を命じました。クラーク裁判官は同様の命令を発行しましたが、控訴が進行できるように9月28日まで延期しました。

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.

segments.src: Missouri voters are starting to receive and return ballots for the November 3 election.

segments.src: A federal appeals court has ordered Missouri to use a Republican-drawn congressional map that dissolves a Kansas City-based Democratic district.
segments.tr: Ein Bundesberufungsgericht hat Missouri angewiesen, eine von Republikanern gezogene Kongresskarte zu verwenden, die einen demokratischen Bezirk mit Sitz in Kansas City aufgelöst hat.

segments.src: The order came even though ballots reflecting the older district lines had already been printed and mailed.
segments.tr: Die Anordnung kam, obwohl Stimmzettel, die die älteren Bezirksgrenzen widerspiegelten, bereits gedruckt und verschickt worden waren.

segments.src: ## The short version
segments.tr: ## Die Kurzversion

segments.src: - **What is being fought over:** Which of two congressional maps Missouri uses in the November 2026 general election. One is the 2022 map. The other is a map passed by the Republican-led legislature in 2025.
segments.tr: - **Worum wird gekämpft:** Welche von zwei Kongresskarten Missouri bei der Generalwahl im November 2026 verwendet. Eine ist die Karte von 2022. Die andere ist eine Karte, die von der von Republikanern geführten Gesetzgebung 2025 verabschiedet wurde.

segments.src: - **Who is affected most directly:** Voters in and around Kansas City. The 2025 map dismantles the 5th Congressional District, which Democratic U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II holds.
segments.tr: - **Wer ist am direktesten betroffen:** Wähler in und um Kansas City. Die Karte von 2025 demontiert den 5. Kongressbezirk, den der demokratische U.S. Rep. Emanuel Cleaver II hält.

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **Wie es ist:** Das 8. U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals entschied am Montag, 21. September, dass die Karte von 2025 verwendet werden muss. Diese Entscheidung ist bis Montag, 28. September, ausgesetzt, um dem Obersten Gerichtshof Zeit zum Handeln zu geben.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **Was kommt als Nächstes:** Die Richter könnten die Anordnung blockieren, sie in Kraft treten lassen oder die Pause verlängern, während sie den Fall berücksichtigen.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## Wie der Streit hierher kam

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: Der Streit hat sich in kurzer Zeit durch staatliche und föderale Gerichte bewegt.

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: Hier ist die Abfolge wie von Nachrichtenmedien berichtet:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025:** Missouris Republikaner verabschiedeten eine neue Kongresskarte als Teil eines breiteren nationalen Vorstoßes, unterstützt von Präsident Donald Trump, um die Wahlbezirke des U.S. House so neu zu zeichnen, dass sie republikanische Kandidaten begünstigen. Die Karte gestaltet den Bezirk der Kansas City-Gegend, den Cleaver vertritt, neu.

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **Referendums-Petition:** Eine Gruppe namens People Not Politicians sammelte Unterschriften für ein Referendum, das es den Wählern erlauben würde, zu entscheiden, ob die neue Karte wirksam werden sollte. Ihre Position ist, dass die Karte nicht verwendet werden kann, bis sich die Wähler äußern.

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **4. August:** Missouri hielt seine Parteienvorwahlen unter Verwendung der Karte von 2025 ab. Beamte des Staates argumentierten, dass die Referendumspetition noch nicht zertifiziert worden war.

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **3. September:** Der Oberste Gerichtshof von Missouri beschloss einstimmig, dass die Karte von 2025 unter Staatsrecht nicht bei den diesjährigen Midterms verwendet werden konnte, bis sie zum Referendum geht. Er wies die Beamten an, die Karte von 2022 zu verwenden.

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **Anfang September:** Der U.S. Supreme Court lehnte es ab, eine Berufung von Missouris Beamten anzunehmen. Stunden später erließ ein Bundesrichter in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, eine einstweilige Anordnung, die jede andere Karte als die von 2025 untersagte. Ein paar Tage danach setzte der Oberste Gerichtshof seine Anordnung aus, die die Anweisung wiederherstellte, die Karte von 2022 zu verwenden.

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **21. September:** Ein Dreirichterpanel des 8. Schaltkreises unterstützte die Karte von 2025 und ordnete ihre Verwendung an. Richter Clark erließ dann eine Anordnung zu diesem Zweck, verzögerte sie aber bis zum 28. September, damit Berufungen fortgesetzt werden könnten.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **Späte Dienstagabend, 22. September:** People Not Politicians forderten den Obersten Gerichtshof auf, die föderale Anordnung zu blockieren. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, der Notfallangelegenheiten aus dem 8. Schaltkreis bearbeitet, setzte eine Frist für Antworten am Mittwoch.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## Warum das Berufungsgericht auf diese Weise entschied

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: Nach Berichten über die Entscheidung basierte die Begründung des 8. Schaltkreises auf einem verfassungsrechtlichen Argument über Konsistenz innerhalb eines einzelnen Wahlzyklus.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: Wähler, sagte das Gericht, sollten Mitglieder des Kongresses in Bezirken wählen, die mit denen in der Vorwahl übereinstimmen.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: Die Augustvorwahl fand unter der Karte von 2025 statt, daher würde ein Wechsel zur Karte von 2022 für November etwa 284.000 Vorwahlwähler in verschiedene Bezirke für die Generalwahl bringen.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: Das Panel schrieb, dass "nur die Verwendung der Karte von 2025 der Verfassung und dem Bundesrecht entspricht."

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: Es bemerkte auch, dass Missourians während der Kampagne "sich zur Wahl in den Kongress anmeldeten, Kandidaten trafen, Kampagnenwerbung anschauten, Kampagnenpost erhielten und unter der Karte von 2025 wählten."

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: Das Gericht befasste sich auch mit dem Purcell-Prinzip.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: Dies ist eine Doktrin, die Gerichte häufig zitieren, um späte Änderungen an Wahlregeln zu vermeiden, die Wähler und Wahlarbeiter verwirren könnten.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: Das Panel behandelte der Berichterstattung zufolge die Karte von 2025, auf der die Vorwahl durchgeführt wurde, als praktischen Status quo.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: Es lehnte daher das Argument ab, dass die Doktrin seine Anordnung blockierte.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## Was die andere Seite sagt

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians und andere Unterstützer der Karte von 2022 sehen es anders.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: Sie verweisen auf die Entscheidung des Obersten Gerichtshofs von Missouri darüber, wie der eigene Referendumsprozess des Staates funktioniert.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: Sie bemerken auch, dass der U.S.

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: Supreme Court hat diesen Monat bereits zweimal in einer Weise gehandelt, die die Karte von 2022 an Ort und Stelle ließ.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: Der Geschäftsführer der Gruppe, Richard von Glahn, hat argumentiert, dass Kartenänderungen in der Mitte einer Wahl das eigentliche Problem sind.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "Man kann Karten in der Mitte einer Wahl nicht ändern," sagte er und drückte Vertrauen in die Position der Gruppe aus.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: Unterstützer der Karte von 2025, einschließlich Missouris Außenminister und republikanischer Kandidaten, die unter den neuen Linien kandidieren, argumentieren, dass die Ergebnisse der Vorwahl und die darauf folgende Kampagnentätigkeit die Karte von 2025 zur geltenden machen.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## Das Stimmzettelproblem

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: Das Timing macht diesen Fall ungewöhnlich.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: Stimmzettel für die Wahl am 3. November wurden mit den Bezirksgrenzen von 2022 gedruckt und verschickt, einschließlich an Überseewähler und Militärwähler.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: Die Briefwahl begann diese Woche.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: Wenn die Karte von 2025 auferlegt wird, müssten Wahlbeamte die Aufgabe erfüllen, Stimmzettel sehr kurz vor dem Wahltag erneut auszugeben oder abzustimmen.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: Die eigene Anordnung des 8. Schaltkreises besagte, dass die Karte von 2025 regieren sollte, aber weder die Gerichte noch die Staatsbeamten haben öffentlich einen vollständigen Plan dargelegt, wie Stimmzettel gehandhabt würden, wenn die Anordnung wirksam wird.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: Missouris Wähler werden auch eine landesweite Frage am 3. November, Proposition A, sehen, die fragt, ob die Karte von 2025 genehmigt werden soll.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians führt Kampagne für eine "Nein"-Abstimmung.

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: Die Gruppe hat berichtet, dass sie Millionen für ihre Unterschriftenkampagne ausgegeben hat, und ein Komitee namens Put Missouri First hat Geld ausgegeben, um sie zu bekämpfen.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Was man als Nächstes beachten sollte

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **Eine Entscheidung des Obersten Gerichtshofs vor dem 28. September.** Angesichts der Frist wird erwartet, dass die Richter entweder über die Notfallbitte entscheiden oder die Pause verlängern.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **Leitlinien für Wahlbeamte.** Lokale Wahrbehörden benötigen klare Anweisungen, welche Bezirke auf Stimmzetteln erscheinen und wie bereits ausgegebene Stimmzettel zu behandeln sind.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **Die größere Rechtsfrage.** Der Fall prüft, wie viel Gewicht Bundesgerichte der Auslegung des Staatsrechts durch einen Obersten Gerichtshof eines Staates geben sollten, und wie weit das Prinzip "keine späten Änderungen" reicht, wenn eine Vorwahl und eine Generalwahl unter verschiedenen Karten durchgeführt werden.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **Das breitere House-Bild.** Der Kansas City-Sitz ist einer von mehreren Kampfplätzen in einem landesweiten Kampf über Bezirksgrenzen vor den Midterms. Das Ergebnis könnte die Balance des U.S. House beeinflussen.

segments.tr: - **Ai bị ảnh hưởng trực tiếp nhất:** Cử tri ở Kansas City và xung quanh. Bản đồ năm 2025 phá vỡ Khu vực Quốc hội thứ 5, được giữ bởi Đại diện Hoa Kỳ Dân chủ Emanuel Cleaver II.

segments.src: - **Where things stand:** The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled on Monday, September 21 that the 2025 map must be used. That ruling is paused until Monday, September 28 to give the Supreme Court time to act.
segments.tr: - **Tình hình hiện tại:** Tòa Phúc thẩm Mạch vòng thứ 8 của Hoa Kỳ đã phán quyết vào thứ Hai, ngày 21 tháng 9 rằng bản đồ năm 2025 phải được sử dụng. Phán quyết đó bị tạm dừng cho đến thứ Hai, ngày 28 tháng 9 để Tòa án Tối cao có thời gian hành động.

segments.src: - **What happens next:** The justices could block the order, let it take effect, or extend the pause while they consider the case.
segments.tr: - **Điều gì sẽ xảy ra tiếp theo:** Các vị thẩm phán có thể chặn lệnh, để nó có hiệu lực, hoặc kéo dài thời gian tạm dừng khi họ xem xét vụ án.

segments.src: ## How the dispute got here
segments.tr: ## Cách tranh chấp diễn ra

segments.src: The fight has moved through state and federal courts in a short time.
segments.tr: Cuộc đấu tranh đã đi qua các tòa án tiểu bang và liên bang trong thời gian ngắn.

segments.src: Here is the sequence as reported by news outlets:
segments.tr: Dưới đây là chuỗi sự kiện như được báo cáo bởi các cơ quan truyền thông:

segments.src: - **2025:** Missouri Republicans passed a new congressional map as part of a wider national push, backed by President Donald Trump, to redraw U.S. House districts in ways that favor Republican candidates. The map reshapes the Kansas City-area district represented by Cleaver.
segments.tr: - **2025:** Những người Cộng hòa Missouri đã thông qua bản đồ quốc hội mới như một phần của nỗ lực quốc gia rộng lớn hơn, được hỗ trợ bởi Tổng thống Donald Trump, để vẽ lại các khu vực Hạ viện Hoa Kỳ theo cách ưa thích các ứng cử viên Cộng hòa. Bản đồ này định hình lại khu vực Kansas City được đại diện bởi Cleaver.

segments.src: - **Referendum petition:** A group called People Not Politicians gathered signatures for a referendum that would let voters decide whether the new map should take effect. Its position is that the map cannot be used until voters weigh in.
segments.tr: - **Kiến nghị trưng cầu ý dân:** Một nhóm gọi là People Not Politicians đã thu thập chữ ký cho một cuộc trưng cầu ý dân sẽ cho phép cử tri quyết định liệu bản đồ mới có nên có hiệu lực hay không. Lập trường của nó là bản đồ không thể được sử dụng cho đến khi cử tri bình chọn.

segments.src: - **August 4:** Missouri held its party primaries using the 2025 map. State officials argued that the referendum petition had not yet been certified.
segments.tr: - **4 tháng 8:** Missouri tổ chức các cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ của đảng sử dụng bản đồ năm 2025. Các quan chức tiểu bang lập luận rằng kiến nghị trưng cầu ý dân chưa được xác nhận.

segments.src: - **September 3:** The Missouri Supreme Court unanimously ruled that, under state law, the 2025 map could not be used in this year's midterms until it goes to a referendum. It directed officials to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **3 tháng 9:** Tòa án Tối cao Missouri đã nhất trí phán quyết rằng, theo luật tiểu bang, bản đồ năm 2025 không thể được sử dụng trong các cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ năm nay cho đến khi nó trưng cầu ý dân. Nó chỉ đạo các quan chức sử dụng bản đồ năm 2022.

segments.src: - **Early September:** The U.S. Supreme Court declined to take up an appeal from Missouri officials. Hours later, a federal district judge in St. Louis, Stephen Clark, issued a temporary order barring any map other than the 2025 one. A few days after that, the Supreme Court stayed his order, which restored the instruction to use the 2022 map.
segments.tr: - **Đầu tháng 9:** Tòa án Tối cao Hoa Kỳ từ chối xem xét kháng cáo từ các quan chức Missouri. Vài giờ sau đó, một thẩm phán tòa án liên bang ở St. Louis, Stephen Clark, đã đưa ra lệnh tạm thời cấm bất kỳ bản đồ nào khác ngoài bản đồ năm 2025. Vài ngày sau đó, Tòa án Tối cao đã giữ lệnh của ông, điều này phục hồi hướng dẫn sử dụng bản đồ năm 2022.

segments.src: - **September 21:** A three-judge panel of the 8th Circuit sided with the 2025 map and ordered its use. Judge Clark then issued an order to that effect but delayed it until September 28 so appeals could proceed.
segments.tr: - **21 tháng 9:** Một hội đồng ba thẩm phán của Mạch vòng thứ 8 đã ủng hộ bản đồ năm 2025 và lệnh sử dụng nó. Thẩm phán Clark sau đó đã đưa ra lệnh theo đó nhưng trì hoãn cho đến ngày 28 tháng 9 để các kháng cáo có thể tiến hành.

segments.src: - **Late Tuesday, September 22:** People Not Politicians asked the Supreme Court to block the federal order. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, who handles emergency matters from the 8th Circuit, set a deadline for responses on Wednesday.
segments.tr: - **Cuối ngày thứ Ba, 22 tháng 9:** People Not Politicians đã yêu cầu Tòa án Tối cao chặn lệnh liên bang. Thẩm phán Brett Kavanaugh, người xử lý các vấn đề khẩn cấp từ Mạch vòng thứ 8, đã đặt hạn chót cho các phản hồi vào thứ Tư.

segments.src: ## Why the appeals court ruled the way it did
segments.tr: ## Tại sao tòa phúc thẩm phán quyết theo cách đó

segments.src: According to reporting on the decision, the 8th Circuit's reasoning turned on a constitutional argument about consistency within a single election cycle.
segments.tr: Theo báo cáo về quyết định, lý luận của Mạch vòng thứ 8 dựa vào tranh luận hiến pháp về tính nhất quán trong một chu kỳ bầu cử duy nhất.

segments.src: Voters, the court said, should elect members of Congress in districts that match the ones used in the primary.
segments.tr: Cử tri, tòa án nói, nên bầu chọn các thành viên Quốc hội ở các khu vực phù hợp với những khu vực được sử dụng trong cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ.

segments.src: The August primary was held under the 2025 map, so switching to the 2022 map for November would place roughly 284,000 primary voters in different districts for the general election.
segments.tr: Cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ tháng 8 được tổ chức dưới bản đồ năm 2025, do đó chuyển sang bản đồ năm 2022 cho tháng 11 sẽ đặt khoảng 284,000 cử tri bầu cử sơ bộ vào các khu vực khác nhau cho cuộc bầu cử tổng quát.

segments.src: The panel wrote that "only use of the 2025 map complies with the Constitution and federal law."
segments.tr: Hội đồng viết rằng "chỉ sử dụng bản đồ năm 2025 tuân thủ Hiến pháp và luật liên bang."

segments.src: It also noted that during the campaign, Missourians "filed to run for Congress, met candidates, watched campaign advertisements, received campaign mail, and voted under the 2025 map."
segments.tr: Nó cũng lưu ý rằng trong chiến dịch, người Missouri "đệ trình để chạy cho Quốc hội, gặp các ứng cử viên, xem các quảng cáo chiến dịch, nhận thư chiến dịch, và bầu cử dưới bản đồ năm 2025."

segments.src: The court also addressed the Purcell principle.
segments.tr: Tòa án cũng đề cập đến nguyên tắc Purcell.

segments.src: This is a doctrine courts often cite for avoiding late changes to election rules that could confuse voters and election workers.
segments.tr: Đây là một học thuyết mà các tòa án thường trích dẫn để tránh những thay đổi muộn trong các quy tắc bầu cử có thể gây nhầm lẫn cho cử tri và những người làm việc bầu cử.

segments.src: The panel reportedly treated the 2025 map, which the primary was run on, as the practical status quo.
segments.tr: Hội đồng được cho là đã coi bản đồ năm 2025, mà cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ được tổ chức dựa trên, như tình trạng hiện thực tế.

segments.src: It therefore rejected the argument that the doctrine blocked its order.
segments.tr: Do đó, nó đã bác bỏ lập luận rằng học thuyết đó đã chặn lệnh của nó.

segments.src: ## What the other side says
segments.tr: ## Phía bên kia nói gì

segments.src: People Not Politicians and other supporters of the 2022 map see it differently.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians và những người ủng hộ khác của bản đồ năm 2022 nhìn nó khác đi.

segments.src: They point to the Missouri Supreme Court's ruling on how the state's own referendum process works.
segments.tr: Họ chỉ đến phán quyết của Tòa án Tối cao Missouri về cách thức hoạt động của quy trình trưng cầu ý dân riêng của tiểu bang.

segments.src: They also note that the U.S.
segments.tr: Họ cũng lưu ý rằng Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: Supreme Court has already acted twice this month in ways that left the 2022 map in place.
segments.tr: Tòa án Tối cao đã hành động hai lần trong tháng này theo cách mà để bản đồ năm 2022 tại chỗ.

segments.src: The group's executive director, Richard von Glahn, has argued that map changes in the middle of an election are the real problem.
segments.tr: Giám đốc điều hành của nhóm, Richard von Glahn, đã lập luận rằng những thay đổi bản đồ ở giữa cuộc bầu cử là vấn đề thực sự.

segments.src: "You cannot change maps in the middle of an election," he said, expressing confidence in the group's position.
segments.tr: "Bạn không thể thay đổi bản đồ ở giữa cuộc bầu cử," ông nói, bày tỏ niềm tin vào vị trí của nhóm.

segments.src: Supporters of the 2025 map, including Missouri's secretary of state and Republican candidates running under the new lines, argue that the primary results and the campaign activity that followed make the 2025 map the operative one.
segments.tr: Những người ủng hộ bản đồ năm 2025, bao gồm thư ký tiểu bang Missouri và những ứng cử viên Cộng hòa chạy dưới các đường mới, lập luận rằng kết quả bầu cử sơ bộ và hoạt động chiến dịch tiếp theo làm cho bản đồ năm 2025 là bản đồ có hiệu lực.

segments.src: ## The ballot problem
segments.tr: ## Vấn đề phiếu bầu

segments.src: The timing is what makes this case unusual.
segments.tr: Thời gian là những gì làm cho vụ án này không bình thường.

segments.src: Ballots for the November 3 election were printed with the 2022 district lines and mailed, including to overseas and military voters.
segments.tr: Những phiếu bầu cho cuộc bầu cử ngày 3 tháng 11 được in với những đường biên khu vực năm 2022 và gửi qua đường bưu điện, bao gồm những cử tri ở nước ngoài và quân sự.

segments.src: Absentee voting began this week.
segments.tr: Bầu cử vắng mặt bắt đầu tuần này.

segments.src: If the 2025 map is imposed, election officials would face the task of reissuing or reconciling ballots very close to Election Day.
segments.tr: Nếu bản đồ năm 2025 được áp dụng, các quan chức bầu cử sẽ phải đối mặt với nhiệm vụ phát hành lại hoặc hòa giải những phiếu bầu rất gần Ngày bầu cử.

segments.src: The 8th Circuit's own order said the 2025 map should govern, but neither the courts nor state officials have publicly laid out a complete plan for how ballots would be handled if the order takes effect.
segments.tr: Lệnh riêng của Mạch vòng thứ 8 nói rằng bản đồ năm 2025 nên cải quyết, nhưng cả tòa án lẫn các quan chức tiểu bang đều chưa công khai đưa ra kế hoạch hoàn chỉnh về cách xử lý những phiếu bầu nếu lệnh có hiệu lực.

segments.src: Missouri voters will also see a statewide question on November 3, Proposition A, which asks whether to approve the 2025 map.
segments.tr: Những cử tri Missouri cũng sẽ thấy một câu hỏi toàn tiểu bang vào ngày 3 tháng 11, Đề xuất A, hỏi liệu có phê duyệt bản đồ năm 2025 hay không.

segments.src: People Not Politicians is campaigning for a "no" vote.
segments.tr: People Not Politicians đang vận động cho một lá phiếu "không".

segments.src: The group has reported spending millions on its signature drive, and a committee called Put Missouri First has spent to oppose it.
segments.tr: Nhóm đã báo cáo chi tiêu hàng triệu đô la cho chiến dịch chữ ký của nó, và một ủy ban gọi là Put Missouri First đã chi tiêu để phản đối nó.

segments.src: ## What to watch next
segments.tr: ## Những gì cần chú ý tiếp theo

segments.src: 1. **A Supreme Court order before September 28.** Given the deadline, the justices are expected either to rule on the emergency request or to extend the pause.
segments.tr: 1. **Một lệnh Tòa án Tối cao trước ngày 28 tháng 9.** Với hạn chót, các thẩm phán được dự kiến sẽ phán quyết về yêu cầu khẩn cấp hoặc kéo dài thời gian tạm dừng.

segments.src: 2. **Guidance for election officials.** Local election authorities will need clear instructions on which districts appear on ballots and how to handle ballots already issued.
segments.tr: 2. **Hướng dẫn cho các quan chức bầu cử.** Các cơ quan bầu cử địa phương sẽ cần các hướng dẫn rõ ràng về những khu vực nào xuất hiện trên phiếu bầu và cách xử lý những phiếu bầu đã được phát hành.

segments.src: 3. **The larger legal question.** The case tests how much weight federal courts should give to a state supreme court's reading of state law, and how far the "no late changes" principle reaches when a primary and general election are held under different maps.
segments.tr: 3. **Vấn đề pháp lý lớn hơn.** Vụ án kiểm tra mức độ trọng lượng mà các tòa án liên bang nên đưa cho việc đọc luật tiểu bang của tòa án tối cao tiểu bang, và nguyên tắc "không thay đổi muộn" đi xa bao nhiêu khi cuộc bầu cử sơ bộ và bầu cử tổng quát được tổ chức dưới những bản đồ khác nhau.

segments.src: 4. **The broader House picture.** The Kansas City seat is one of several battlegrounds in a nationwide fight over district lines ahead of the midterms. The outcome could affect the balance of the U.S. House.
segments.tr: 4. **Bức tranh Hạ viện rộng lớn hơn.** Ghế Kansas City là một trong số các chiến trường trong cuộc đấu tranh toàn quốc về các đường biên khu vực trước các cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ. Kết quả có thể ảnh hưởng đến sự cân bằng của Hạ viện Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: ## What Missouri voters can do
segments.tr: ## Những gì cử tri Missouri có thể làm

segments.src: Because the rules are still unsettled, voters should rely on official sources instead of social media rumors:
segments.tr: Bởi vì các quy tắc vẫn chưa được giải quyết, cử tri nên dựa vào các nguồn chính thức thay vì những tin đồn trên mạng xã hội:

segments.src: - Confirm your registration and your current congressional district with your local election authority or the Missouri Secretary of State's website.
segments.tr: - Xác nhận đăng ký của bạn và khu vực quốc hội hiện tại của bạn với cơ quan bầu cử địa phương của bạn hoặc trang web của Thư ký Tiểu bang Missouri.

segments.src: - If you already have an absentee ballot, follow the instructions that came with it and watch for updates from your county election office.
segments.tr: - Nếu bạn đã có phiếu bầu vắng mặt, hãy làm theo hướng dẫn đi kèm với nó và theo dõi các bản cập nhật từ văn phòng bầu cử của quận của bạn.

segments.src: - Check official announcements before returning a ballot, since guidance could change if the courts act.
segments.tr: - Kiểm tra các thông báo chính thức trước khi trả lại phiếu bầu, vì hướng dẫn có thể thay đổi nếu các tòa án hành động.
